summary: Master Tableau with our Fundamentals Training Course. Learn data visualization techniques and enhance your skills to make informed decisions.
lede: Tableau visual analytics helps data analysts and reporting professionals turn structured data into interactive dashboards. Learners practice connecting and shaping data, creating calculated fields and visualizations, using table calculations and dashboard actions, and optimizing extracts and publishing workbooks; server governance and advanced predictive modeling are addressed conceptually.
audienceIntro: This course is specifically structured for professionals who are responsible for analyzing data, building reports, and communicating metrics to stakeholders. It serves practitioners who need to transition from traditional spreadsheet tools to robust visual analytics platforms.
modules: Tableau Architecture and Data Connection Fundamentals
Core Visualization Techniques and The Marks Card
Advanced Chart Types and Spatial Analytics
Advanced Interactivity with Parameters and Sets
prerequisites: Participants must have a basic understanding of data structures, such as familiarity with Excel tables, rows, and columns. No prior coding, SQL, or advanced statistical experience is required. You must have Tableau Desktop installed on your machine (a commercial license or active 14-day trial) prior to the first session.
